title: The Night Circus
author: Erin Morgenstern
summary: A mysterious circus arrives without warning and opens only at night, its black-and-white tents full of impossible wonders. Inside it, two young magicians have been bound since childhood into a contest they do not fully understand.
readIf: you want a dreamy, sensory fantasy to wander through, with a gentle love story.
skipIf: you want pace or a firm plot, because it drifts through time and favours atmosphere.

pairings.reason: Same author, a more intricate and story-within-story fantasy with a similar fondness for wonder.
A shorter, lighter fairy tale with some of the same romance and magic.
Another lush, melancholy love story with a magical bargain at its heart.
